summary: Accept the assisted Luna LOP3 proof completion with unchanged semantics and full provenance.

examined.reason: Plain form has completed all original obligations with exact worker source, fresh replay, coordinator source/statement inspection and separate advisory GLM accept. No new assumptions or decoder restrictions.
Adds only plain lop3.b32 and its source, target, immediate-only range, exact patch/replay provenance and missing predicate-producing siblings; 24 selected forms.
Assisted continuation explicitly counts coordinator helper proofs and diagnosis, prior failed calls and ten within-call build failures; no held-out/generalization or cost-effectiveness claim.
The exact frozen five helper proofs are reused unchanged; no additional instruction-specific lemmas or computation inserted.
Same total pure result interface; table is operation data, not an extra register operand.
New catalog member directly uses leaf lowering and result relation; functionality rechecked without changing generic nondeterministic semantics.
Existing program and claims unchanged under the extended catalog.
Existing loop/existence/termination claims unchanged and example rechecked.
No scalar state, memory semantics, branch or execution rule changed.
Audit gains entries only; concurrent fragment unchanged.
Selected sequential form adds no concurrency, raw-module or hardware guarantee.
Section coverage remains unassessed; selected-form count is not full coverage.
Kernel proof validity remains separate from source fidelity and advisory review.
Existing prompt, schema, model settings, total deadline and no-retry route unchanged; one completed request recorded.

results.method: Core scripts/check.sh; fresh worker replay; generic helper examples; both frozen LOP3 drivers; array example; TorchLean integration; source/statement/provenance review; exact candidate and unchanged-contract hashes; Stratic validation and whitespace checks
results.environment: Linux, pinned Lean 4.34.0, verified local PTX 9.4 source. Final checks make no inference calls.
results.evidence: Core checks passed on tree 3b34ff4d15c744b40b0a28fa0d6091cd85837b5b: 1568 dependency reports with only standard Lean axioms, 24 accepted forms, 1318 archived members across 17 archives, 106 worker regressions, 26 ledger tests and 7 inventory tests. Final tree changes only a preparation-error-count sentence in the continuation report, without changing any tested code, contract, driver or evidence. Extra-check pre/post snapshots match this final tree. Generic examples, original universal/concrete LOP3 drivers and array example pass; TorchLean integration passes with 363 exact dependency reports. Independent fresh replay of exact worker patch also passes. Coordinator reread source and inspected minterm index order, guards, aliases, targets, range-checking and exact decoder properties. GLM advisory accept is separate. Worker output is integrated byte-for-byte and original public obligations are unchanged. Prior three failed calls remain preserved; the fourth call contains ten failed builds before success. Raw vendor/model transcripts are excluded from public evidence.
